properties.rationale: User (who:ajs, standing policy from 2026-07-23): validation happens through the trials programme — docs/trials/ is where "built the right thing" is exercised against operational intent; formal validation-kind Verification nodes are not this project's tracking mechanism. Re-fired because cap:kpp joined the set (37 → 38). Pointed here: the tests prove a breach is computed from stated contributions, but whether the THRESHOLDS people set are the right ones, and whether a 0.95-severity finding actually stops someone trading away what it protects, cannot be established by any test. Those are answered by a real programme with real stakes — which is precisely the acquisition context the vocabulary came from.
